;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Gaza border protests]]
**The [[Israel Defense Forces]] (IDF) open fire on a group of [[Palestinian people|Palestinian]] men trying to sabotage the [[Israel]]i-[[Gaza Strip|Gazan]] border fence, killing three and injuring two others. The IDF also attacks a [[Hamas]] outpost near the border, stating that the location was used to launch incendiary kites and other objects in an attempt to burn Israeli fields. [https://www.jpost.com/Arab-Israeli-Conflict/IDF-strikes-Hamas-outpost-in-Gaza-used-as-launching-pad-for-attack-kites-553601 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**Hamas releases videos showing dozens of Palestinians successfully breaching the fence and infiltrating Israel. [http://www.israelnationalnews.com/News/News.aspx/245490 (Israel National News)]
*[[Kashmir insurgency]]
**Two days of clashes in Indian-administrated [[Jammu and Kashmir (state)|Jammu and Kashmir]] leaves eight militants and nine civilians dead, while over 100 protesters are injured during anti-India demonstrations. [https://www.benarnews.org/english/news/bengali/professor-death-05072018144803.html (Benar News)]
*[[Pakistan]]i [[Ministry of Interior (Pakistan)|Interior Minister]] [[Ahsan Iqbal]] is shot at following a rally in [[Narowal]], [[Punjab, Pakistan|Punjab]]. A bullet pierces his right shoulder. He is in stable condition now and the gunman has since been arrested, according to Government Officials. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/05/06/world/asia/pakistan-assassination-attempt.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://nation.com.pk/07-May-2018/ahsan-escapes-assassination-bid (''The Nation'')]

*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**A mosque being used for voter registration is bombed in [[Khost]], [[Afghanistan]], killing at least 14 people and injuring 33. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/roadside-bomb-kills-shopkeepers-heading-afghan-market-54968306 (ABC News)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economy of France]]
**[[France|French]] economy minister [[Bruno Le Maire]] says [[Air France]] may collapse over ongoing strike action and the state will not bail the firm out despite owning 14.3% of parent [[Air France-KLM]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business-44021431 (BBC)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Flash floods]] cause transportation issues and damage buildings in [[Ankara]], the capital of [[Turkey]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/av/world-europe-44022350/turkey-floods-cars-swept-away-in-ankara-streets (BBC)]
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**At [[Leilani Estates, Hawaii|Leilani Estates]], 26 homes and 4 buildings were destroyed by [[Kīlauea]], forcing 1700 people to leave their homes. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hawaii-volcano/go-now-hawaii-residents-warned-as-eruptions-spread-idUSKBN1I80M7 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Malaysia]]n authorities announce sixteen arrests connected to an international [[human trafficking]] ring. The arrests follow the seizure of modified tanker ship MV ''Etra'' in Malaysian waters on Tuesday with 127 [[Sri Lanka]]n migrants on board being smuggled to [[New Zealand]] and [[Australia]]. The arrests include seven people captured aboard a fishing vessel used to transfer migrants onto MV ''Etra''. [http://www.scmp.com/news/asia/southeast-asia/article/2144887/people-smuggling-ship-127-sri-lankans-board-busted-route (''The South China Morning Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Lebanese general election, 2018]]
**[[Lebanon]] holds its first [[Elections in Lebanon|parliamentary election]] since 2009. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-44020061 (BBC)]
*The Electoral Commission of [[Zambia]] says it will disqualify anybody who commits violence in the campaign for upcoming by-[[Elections in Zambia|elections]] slated for June. [https://www.lusakatimes.com/2018/05/06/electoral-commission-of-zambia-to-disqualify-violent-parties/ (''The Lusaka Times'')]
*In an interview granted to the newspaper ''[[El Comercio (Peru)|El Comercio]]'', the Peruvian president, [[Martín Vizcarra]], ruled out presenting himself for re-election in 2021 or calling early elections. Vizcarra, as vice president, took office late March after former President [[Pedro Pablo Kuczynski]] resigned due to a corruption scandal and strong pressures of the [[Congress of the Republic of Peru|Congress]]. [http://www.americatv.com.pe/noticias/actualidad/martin-vizcarra-no-sere-candidato-presidencial-2021-n320819 (América Televisión)]
*[[Far-right politics in the United Kingdom]]
**Thousands of far-right activists attend a protest in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]] amid a recent crackdown on far-right activity on [[social media]]. Guest speakers included former [[English Defence League]] leader [[Tommy Robinson (activist)|Tommy Robinson]], [[Vice (magazine)|''Vice'']] magazine co-founder [[Gavin McInnes]], and [[UK Independence Party]] (UKIP) leader [[Gerard Batten]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/may/06/thousands-of-far-right-protesters-march-in-london-in-support-of-free-speech (''The Guardian'')]
